availability_audit: Chronology anchor: Route 113/114 and Meteor Falls is reached after Mauville/Wattson (cap 30) via Route 111 -> Route 112 -> Fiery Path, per Game Book C20/C21. Every member below is in work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map the player has already passed on the way to Route 113/114 and Meteor Falls: Seaspray Cave B1F (Sneasel), Rusturf Tunnel (Drilbur), Petalburg City Old Rod (Magikarp), Route 102 (Togepi), Mauville Game Corner (Litten), Granite Cave 1F (Abra). No Route 118+, Mt. Pyre, desert-interior or post-Flannery sources are used. Mega Ring earned from Steven after Brawly (C13); Gyaradosite stone window 20. Meteor Falls is reached west along Route 114 from Fallarbor per Game Book C21, so every source map above is behind the player. Adds NewMauville_Entrance (Magnezone gate 30). Gyaradosite stone window 20; the Mega Ring is earned from Steven after Brawly (C13).
plan: One battle, two complete six-member rosters, twelve opponents. The composite roster is overwhelmingly Rock, Ground, Fire and Psychic, so Mega Gyarados is the honest ace: Waterfall is 2x or 4x into eight of the twelve (both Lunatone/Solrock, Minior, Aerodactyl, Magcargo 4x, Camerupt 4x, Hippowdon, Houndoom), its Mold Breaker ignores the Levitate on Lunatone and Claydol, and Crunch is 2x into the four Psychics. Leading it beside Incineroar puts two Intimidates on the board immediately, which is the cheapest answer to a physical half containing Choice Band Crobat, Mightyena, Minior and a Mega Aerodactyl. Excadrill covers the Rock and Fire bodies on the ground, Weavile's Ice is 2x into Aerodactyl, Crobat and Hippowdon while Knock Off strips the two White Herbs that both Shell Smash plans depend on, and Magnezone's Flash Cannon is 2x into every Rock member. Things to respect: Magcargo's Simple turns Shell Smash into +4/+4/+4 with the White Herb undoing the drops, Minior does the same behind Shields Down, and sand only exists if Hippowdon actually comes in.
